East African Legislative Assembly (Powers and Privileges) Act, 2003
THE EAST AFRICAN COMMUNITY
Date of assent 9th October, 2003
Date of commencement 31st January, 2004
An Act to declare and define powers, privileges and immunities of the East
African Legislative Assembly and of the Members of the Committees of the
Assembly, to regulate admittance to the precincts of the Assembly, to secure
freedom of speech in the Assembly, to provide for summoning of witnesses
and protection of officers of the Assembly and to provide for related
matters.
by the East African Community and assented to by the President of the
ENACTED
United Republic of Tanzania, the President of the Republic of Kenya and the
President of the Republic of Uganda.
